headline: Multimodalは生成からAction Spaceへ
deck: video生成だけでなくworld model、3D agent、roboticsまで含めると、2025年後半のmultimodal進展はinteraction/action spaceの拡大として見えてくる。

blocks.text: DeepMindはGenie 3、Gemini Robotics 1.5、SIMA 2、Gemini 3を別eventとして展開し、interactive world、physical action、3D agentへ対象を広げた。Sora 2はaudio-video generation、MiniMaxはM2とHailuo 2.3を並行展開した。research prototype、limited-partner robotics、GA API、product rolloutは同一availabilityとして扱わない。

must_cover_coverage.requirement: DeepMindのresearch prototype・limited partner access・GA APIを区別
world modelとroboticsを同一製品releaseとして扱わない
MiniMax M2/Hailuo 2.3/M2.1をclient-rendered indexからitem-level verificationした境界
性能比較はvendor claimに限定

boundary_coverage.requirement: The preserved DeepMind index snapshot is paginated and its first page is not a complete H2 archive; item-level first-party pages were used during interactive verification.
Research prototypes, limited-partner robotics access, and generally available API models must remain distinct.
Primary-source verification establishes the bounded facts recorded here; it does not convert vendor, project, or author evaluations into independent reproduction.
The preserved `minimax.io/news` landing snapshot is client-rendered and sparse; item-level first-party MiniMax release notes/news were used during interactive verification.
